page=canvas(size=(180 mm,150 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf")
p=plot(size=(100 mm,70 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 10 mm), size=(60 mm, 40 mm)),frame="box",
    x=axis(range=(0,2),ticks=[0,1,2],minor_ticks=[0.5,1,1.5],tick_direction="in",tick_length=2 mm,minor_tick_length=1 mm,grid="both"),
    y=axis(scale="log",range=(1,100),ticks=[1,10,100],minor_ticks=[2,10,20],format=".0f",tick_direction="inout",tick_length=4 mm,minor_tick_length=2 mm,grid="both"),
    style=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf",grid_color="#aabbcc",grid_line_width=0.2 mm,grid_line_dash=[1 mm,2 mm]))
p.line(x=[0,1,2],y=[1,10,100])
page.add(p)

p=plot(size=(100 mm,70 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 10 mm), size=(60 mm, 40 mm)),
      x=axis(range=(0,2),ticks=[0,1,2],format=".0f"),
      y=axis(range=(0,4)),
      style=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf"))
p.scatter(x=[0,1,2],y=[0,2,4],label="Measured")
p.line(x=[0,1,2],y=[0,2,4],label="Model")

a=page.add(p,anchor="plot_top_left",offset=(30 mm,25 mm))
b=page.add(p,size=(120 mm, 80 mm),anchor="plot_top_left",offset=(105 mm,25 mm))
page.add(rect(size=(1 mm, 1 mm)),anchor=center,target=a.data(x=1,y=2))

      y=axis(range=(0,4),label="Long signal label",tick_labels=false,grid="major"),
